reason: A short note to [Boyfriend] saying "we can't stay that way" and "Thanks for everything" does break up, but never uses grateful or appreciate.
A letter to Theo urging him to "share something real" since "friendship grows out of listening", with no mention of the chatbot.
The reply to Wen praises the story and says "I would have liked more structure at the end", but never mentions the dialogue.
The quoted reply says "I will not use AI to shape this essay" and "I plan to write my own section".
The note to Marcus complains about the app and says "Please stop using it" but never says the sender is deleting it.
Instead of apologizing it thanks Sam for "generosity" and rambles about messaging apps until it is cut off.
It misreads the situation, telling Elias "You were chosen by everyone", and never mentions the team or tryouts.
A rambling note to Leila that encourages her ("sing bravely today!") about her performance tonight, cut off mid-sentence.
"Hi, it was help! Sincerely, [Me]" never actually thanks anyone or mentions Bjorn or the car.
It ends the relationship over long distance but calls it an "unhealthy cycle" and never conveys appreciation, before being cut off.
Addressed to [Neighbor], it declines the Wednesday book club because of "an upcoming evening course" and is cut off mid-sentence.
Although muddled, it says "I am sorry" for the digging and offers to come "tend the beds myself, planting new flowers".
A letter to Theo urging him to talk to people rather than rely on "ChatGPT or any other artificial intelligence tool", cut off mid-sentence.
Under "Here is what you might include" it gives a bulleted list of activities and never wishes him a happy birthday.
"Dear [Sam], I'm sorry we had the screen. It distracted us" is an apology for being on the screen.
"Dear [friend], I'm sorry I was late" apologizes for being late but leaves out Gabriela's name.
"Dear [Sister], I'm sorry about the sweater" apologizes and offers to fix it.
A comforting message to Luca about "the first calculus test" saying "effort counts" and "You are not alone".
It gives two bullet tips ("Use AI for ideas, then edit") instead of a reply to the study group.
The message to [Zainab] says parts of her section "do not include proper in-text citations" and asks her to fix them, but gives no Wednesday deadline before being cut off.
The note to Lena thanks her ("Thank you so much for your thought") and declines with "I cannot come along".
The quoted message apologizes that "we were late" and offers dishes, never owning that the sender forgot the birthday dinner.
"Thank her for the water!" is an instruction, not a note to Mrs. Okafor.
The message to Zainab says "your part's citation section is missing" but gives no Wednesday deadline.
It thanks Lena "for considering us and trying out our services", which is the app's point of view, not a coworker declining.
It takes MCP to mean "Microsoft Cognitive Platform" and says there is "no direct connection", so it misunderstands the topic, and it is cut off.
"I'm busy. Thanks for the idea." declines and thanks her, but names neither Lena nor the dating app.
Instead of comforting Tunde it talks about a "key player" who failed to score and "your absence", and it is cut off.
It invents "Dr. Watson and Clarisse" meeting at a bar and never describes the FBI investigation or Buffalo Bill.
A thank-you to [Coworker's Name] for covering "our Friday shift"; Diego appears only in the lead-in, and the graduation is never named.
